text:
maria: quick one 1 - i'm prototyping a small change in the TS browser SDK to surface a consent prompt before sending optional telemetry headers (routing & metering). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/2144

ben: what's in the header and why is consent needed now?

maria: header is `X-RW-Client-Meta: v1;routeHints=1;metering=1` (compact). Consent: some customers in EU want explicit opt-in for client-origin telemetry that includes inferred route tags. legal asked we default to OFF in browsers. server & node SDKs keep prior default (off for metering, on for minimal routing) but we need to be explicit in changelog.

oliver: from platform side: ingestion will treat `client_meta` as advisory. we need to tag records with `client_origin=true` when header present and preserve `route_hint` fields. dashboards: UX wants a toggle to overlay client-origin traces.

ben: product question: do we lose any critical routing info if browsers stop sending? some web apps use client-side hints to reduce cold-cache misses.

maria: it's advisory. server-side routing still authoritative. client hints only help with local batching & prefetch UX. we will ship a migration note for customers relying on client hints and recommend server-side pinning for critical flows.

tasha: ops: can we add a short canary window? legal wants consent flow in browsers before enabling header. propose rollout: 1) SDK change to show consent UI but default consent=false, 2) feature-flagged enable for internal beta orgs only, 3) after 2 weeks enable for customers who explicitly opt-in via console toggle.

oliver: ingestion needs two changes: a) new boolean field `client_origin` in raw events, b) index `route_hint_client` separately. also we need a migration to backfill `client_origin=false` (do nothing) so existing metrics are unchanged. if we add `client_origin` to route matrices, dashboards must keep server units as canonical default.

ben: telemetry team request: record `consent_source` (ui / persisted_cookie / server) when header sent so we can measure adoption and troubleshoot.

maria: SDK will attach `consent_source=ui` when user gives consent in prompt. for serverless single-page apps that serialize config, we will persist user choice in localStorage and tag `persisted_cookie` on subsequent requests. added note in README.

tasha: privacy ops: we should keep minimal PII out of headers. confirm no user id or email sent.

maria: confirmed. header only contains binary flags and optional route hint id (opaque string). no PII.

oliver: UI asks: show adoption tile "Client telemetry consented" and default it off. add a small banner on route dashboards when client-origin data present saying "Some data comes from client-side hints (opt-in)."

ben: quota teams: if clients start sending `metering=1` we may see changes in dashboard estimates. plan: treat client metering as advisory and do not surface it in billing pages. create per-route stacked view (server vs client estimated) in the console metrics area.

maria: SDK compatibility note: this is non-breaking. browser SDK bump minor (1.5.0) with consent flow. node SDK will get a small opt-in flag in constructor for parity but no UI.

tasha: legal wants an audit log entry when consent is toggled in console and in SDK (persist events to ingestion with `consent_event=true`). can ingestion own that?

oliver: yes ingestion can accept `consent_event` payloads and write to an audit stream. we'll add `consent_event` boolean + `consent_action` string. need schema docs.

ben: rollout timeline?

maria: propose: tomorrow merge SDK PR behind feature flag; this week internal beta for 10% of orgs; next week console toggle & ingestion mapping; two-week customer opt-in window; then decide if we keep SDK prompt or remove after adoption.

tasha: ops: schedule backfill window to be NOOP. do not infer consent retroactively. backfill is explicitly disallowed by privacy team.

oliver: ingestion PR will include schema + index changes and the audit stream. i'll own it. we'll keep dashboard overlays off by default.

maria: UI folks - need consent copy: short text for prompt + tooltip language explaining advisory nature and privacy safeguards.

ben: i'll draft product copy: "Allow Redwood to send anonymized client hints to improve routing and estimate usage. No personal data is transmitted. You can revoke at any time."

maria: perfect. final asks: @oliver (ingest schema + audit stream), @tasha (ops/legal sign-off), @ben (product copy + dashboard banner), @ui (consent prompt mock).

prod-bot: CI: SDK unit tests passed, e2e flaky retrying.

maria: will wait for legal sign-off before wide rollout. thanks all.
